title: Reindeer Christmas Wrapping Paper, Green Gift Wrap Roll with Holly and Gold Stars, Satin Wrapping Paper, Elegant Holiday Gift Wrap
description:
Leaping cream reindeer, red-berried holly and little golden stars on a deep forest green: a classic, elegant wrapping paper that makes every present look special under the tree.

DETAILS
- Satin-finish wrapping paper, one continuous roll
- Two sizes: 70 x 100 cm (28 x 39 in) or 70 x 200 cm (28 x 79 in)
- Printed on one side

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the UK and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships within Europe and the UK.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
